run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the sum of all proper divisors of a natural number
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple inputs to verify proper divisor sum calculations
review_f_gold: review f_gold which iterates up to sqrt(num) to find divisor pairs
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the sum of all proper divisors plus one
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use integer division instead of float division for divisors
